sentences.text:
Appellant has been arrested on 28.05.2024 in connection with Crime No.296 of 2024 registered at Police Station - Shajahanabad, Bhopal (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n)
and 506 of the IPC and Sections 3(1)(w-ii), 3(2)(v) and 3(2)(v-a) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.
Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that the appellant has falsely been implicated in the case and he has not committed any offence.
It is submitted that the allegation against the appellant is that he has made physical relations with the victim on the false pretext of marriage with the 2 CRA-8992-2024 victim, who is also major.
It is further submitted that the appellant is in custody since 28.05.2024.
He is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions that may be imposed by this Court while considering this appeal for bail.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail.

Per contra, learned counsel appearing for the State has vehemently opposed the appeal and has contended that it is not a simple case that the appellant has made physical relations on false pretext of marriage, however, he has suppressed the fact that he being married and has made physical relations.
When he refused to marry the victim, she came to know the fact that the appellant is already married and made physical relation on false pretext of marriage.
In view of the aforesaid, he has prayed for dismissal of this appeal.

sentences.text: Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that the appellant is already married person and has hidden the fact of his first marriage.
He has instigated the present victim to make physical relations on such false pretext of marriage, this Court does not deem it appropriate to allow this appeal at this stage.
Accordingly, the appeal for bail is hereby rejected.
